card.name: Classroom accommodation and accessibility lists
card.fires_on: Separators and connecting words inside lists of school accommodations or accessible formats, such as list dashes, slashes, 'such as', and 'large' before 'print'.

modes.label: List dashes
modes.description: A dash starting the next item in a bulleted list of student accommodations.
modes.example: bathroom breaks - Book bag on wheels - Help with note taking - Extra time to get to and from class (leave before the bell) <<->> Stretching or walking to relieve stress

modes.label: Large print formats
modes.description: The word large or larger naming an accessible format, such as large print, for people with vision problems.
